population.method: Total resident population; five-year survey estimate.

homeValue.method: Median homeowner-reported value of owner-occupied housing, not a market sale price.

rent.method: Median monthly gross rent, including utilities.

rentBurden.method: Sum of 30–34.9%, 35–39.9%, 40–49.9% and 50%+ bins, divided by total renter households minus not-computed households. Component published 90% margins are retained; no derived percentage margin is claimed.

car.method: Share of workers age 16+ using this mode; working from home is included in the denominator. Component published 90% margins are retained; no derived percentage margin is claimed.

transit.method: Share of workers age 16+ using this mode; working from home is included in the denominator. Component published 90% margins are retained; no derived percentage margin is claimed.

bike.method: Share of workers age 16+ using this mode; working from home is included in the denominator. Component published 90% margins are retained; no derived percentage margin is claimed.

walk.method: Share of workers age 16+ using this mode; working from home is included in the denominator. Component published 90% margins are retained; no derived percentage margin is claimed.

home.method: Share of workers age 16+ using this mode; working from home is included in the denominator. Component published 90% margins are retained; no derived percentage margin is claimed.

other.method: Share of workers age 16+ using this mode; working from home is included in the denominator. Component published 90% margins are retained; no derived percentage margin is claimed.

longCommute.method: Sum of 60–89 and 90+ minute bins divided by workers who commute. No mean travel time is inferred from bins. Component published 90% margins are retained; no derived percentage margin is claimed.
